reviews.text: The fight on the staircase, a single take that lasts several minutes, is a particular highlight. It draws humour from the violence, too, and James McAvoy is having a ball as an unhinged operative.
reviews.author: Akhil Arora

reviews.text: Leitch’s film lacks zip, zilch, and zero in the style department.
reviews.author: Don Shanahan

reviews.text: The talented cast and formal technique feel trampled by the overstylized and undermotivated narrative.
reviews.author: Brian Eggert

reviews.text: A textbook example of style over substance.
reviews.author: Drew Dietsch

reviews.text: A delightfully swift film that pays no credence to past grey depictions of the Eastern Bloc. Instead, it insists that every hotel room be bathed in neon and every rain-streaked window should be smashed by a white-blonde Theron crashing through it.
reviews.author: Ben Turner

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is another movie largely defined by its cool-as-ice characters, its action-packed set-pieces, and its awesome mix tape of classic tunes readily available for iTunes download.
reviews.author: Matt Brunson

reviews.text: Visually it's this smash-up of Argento and Refn with the long-take swagger of Cuaron and the bottomless sleaze of Verhoeven ladled liberally over top
reviews.author: Jason Adams

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde has so much kick-ass action you will be begging for studios to start working on a sequel.
reviews.author: Leo Brady

reviews.text: A violent, arty spy flick that doesn't just open the door for Charlize Theron to create an effective spy franchise; it kicks it off its hinges.
reviews.author: Richard Crouse

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde may be a throwback to the Cold War but let's hope it's the future of action cinema.
reviews.author: David Bax

reviews.text: The stunts may look convincing and heavy-hitting, but the violence is severe and mean-spirited; there's little fun to be found in the gritty way the mayhem is portrayed.
reviews.author: Mike Massie

reviews.text: Not a perfect spy flick, but I'd be up for more Atomic Blonde movies.
reviews.author: Paul McGuire Grimes

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde skates by on its moments of intensity; just don't expect to be quite so titillated in the moments between the punches and gunfire.
reviews.author: Leigh Monson

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde shows its cards quickly.
reviews.author: Richard Propes

reviews.text: But the film's strong emphasis on the fight scenes and its creative use of music means the plot doesn't get the necessary reinforcement it boldly deserves.
reviews.author: Kelechi Ehenulo

reviews.text: When "Atomic Blonde" hits, it hits with ferocity, driving home that Charlize Theron should be the biggest action star in the world and David Leitch has action chops for days.
reviews.author: Brent McKnight

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde falls squarely in the middle between James Bond and John Wick, bringing the exciting spy chase of the former while upping the violence level, but not quite reaching that of the latter.
reviews.author: Damond Fudge

reviews.text: I'm here for more of these kind of action movies.
reviews.author: Avaryl Halley

reviews.text: This movie was intense.
reviews.author: Andrew Galdi

reviews.text: There's no getting around that a great deal of this movie is tedious and predictable.
reviews.author: Steven Prokopy

reviews.text: The badass that is this film is reminiscent not only of John Wick in terms of fights and even color patterns at times, it also reminds of a bit of James Bond mixed with Salt ...
reviews.author: Emilie Black

reviews.text: It all rests on Theron being a kind of female James Bond. But it's not even a good Bond-type film - the plot is too flimsy for it to work.
reviews.author: Rhodé Marshall

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is a cool, slick little movie whose only real sin was coming close enough to greatness that all of its shortcomings are highlighted ... in neon lights.
reviews.author: Dan Scully

reviews.text: When it focuses on double and triple-crosses, the film becomes a slog. Forget all that. Watch the impeccably made action scenes, the feel of the film, and the powerful Charlize Theron performance that anchors everything.
reviews.author: Tim Brennan

reviews.text: If you like blockbusters that favour style over substance, fun over functionality, archetypal over auteurial - you wouldn't get anything else that is as stylish or fun or archetypal as this.
reviews.author: Charlotte Harrison

reviews.text: podcast review
reviews.author: Julian Lytle

reviews.text: Combined with an eclectic 1980s soundtrack, Atomic Blonde is grittier, more violent and full of confidence, and with Theron steering the wheel, it's hard not to enjoy the journey.
reviews.author: Katie Smith-Wong

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde's visual sensibilities and spectacular, gritty fight scenes receive strong support from a cast that plays the various notes of this film's tone, dialog, and pace to perfection.
reviews.author: Gabriel Ricard

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde becomes a bit like watching a snake eat its own tail, but it's undulating toxicity is so enthralling, we hardly mind its digestion process.
reviews.author: Nicholas Bell

reviews.text: It's too damn hard to follow, it's too wrapped up in its own cleverness, it's too damn long.
reviews.author: Rhys Tarling

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde has a short fuse and packs a big bang.
reviews.author: Linda and Al Lerner

reviews.text: tomic Blonde easily surpasses the last umpty-ump Bond films in dash, inventiveness, and delivering on those empowerment fantasies.
reviews.author: Noah Berlatsky

reviews.text: While Atomic Blonde is fairly predictable and not entirely an original concept, it executes its bone cracking, blood-spewing, and intense action with breakneck speed in a brutally satisfying way that is undoubtedly entertaining.
reviews.author: Chris Sawin

reviews.text: A perfect excuse to enjoy a couple of hours of entertainment with no complexes if we know how to forgive its plot confusion. [Full Review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Víctor López G.

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde looks and feels different than any action movie before it. It takes every beat with a spring in its step. However, when it has to get down to business, it gets down to business.
reviews.author: Karl Delossantos

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde had good flow and pacing and just the right amount of action so it didn't go over the top.
reviews.author: Allison Rose

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is a groundbreaking tour de force for the spy genre. The way the story is written and told makes you want to see it again as soon as the credits roll.
reviews.author: Sara Clements

reviews.text: Peel back the fetishized fight scenes, neon lights and '80s soundtrack, and you're not left with much.
reviews.author: Josh Goller

reviews.text: Had Atomic Blonde sped up the pace of its glacial first hour, ditched the pseudo-intellectual bravado and focused on its lead and not the trappings surrounding her, it would have been an instant action-flick classic.
reviews.author: Ryan Syrek

reviews.text: A beautiful, thrilling film that elevates its action to a level of art rarely seen in this genre.
reviews.author: Mattie Lucas

reviews.text: It is relentless in the way it makes its theme seep through to the audience. Its gritty depravity is overt and well distilled. It gets its point across. And that point will haunt you with its dissoluteness.
reviews.author: Andrew Kendall

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde might not have the most original story but the fight scenes and overall aesthetic of the movie are good enough to overlook that.
reviews.author: Kaitlyn Booth

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is best as a showcase for Charlize Theron as action star, and to prove that women can be tough enough for any job.
reviews.author: Cate Marquis

reviews.text: If you're gonna go with style over substance, I think that style had better be good.
reviews.author: Dan Murrell

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is a captivating, violent, fun and sexy adaptation of Anthony Johnson's graphic novel. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Nicolás Ruiz

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is pure action blockbuster, so if you enjoy jaw-dropping action scenes and hyper-cool design, all set to a great soundtrack, then you'll love it.
reviews.author: Rachael Mead

reviews.text: To her credit, throughout the entire labyrinthine affair, Theron is suave, slick and smooth, punching her way into our hearts.
reviews.author: Deborah Cornelious

reviews.text: The script does offer up a surprise or two to keep the tension suitably taut.
reviews.author: Paula Fleri-Soler

reviews.text: While Atomic Blonde may be a novelty, it more than stands on its own merits. It is a quality action flick, high-octane and sexy and entertaining as hell.
reviews.author: Allen Adams

reviews.text: It can be a blast, just not an atomic one.
reviews.author: Doug Jamieson

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde has a talented cast, but they're wasted on flat, bland characters.
reviews.author: Amanda Greever

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is like an amusement park ride, the adrenaline is high and you'll have a good time but ultimately it's over and you're off to find a bigger thrill.
reviews.author: Sherin Nicole

reviews.text: There's enough to like about Atomic Blonde that it's not a total disaster, and most scenes the feature McAvoy are wholly entertaining.
reviews.author: Louisa Moore

reviews.text: Leitch's film feels drenched in spray paint... permeates its way into every aspect of "Atomic Blonde" from cinematography to the action sequences to the acting performances.
reviews.author: Matt Ward

reviews.text: What a relief it is to watch a popcorn flick without having to suffer massively offensive depictions of women.
reviews.author: Li Lai

reviews.text: The beginning and end are fabulous, the middle is dull and slow. Terrific action, great styling and a female gaze; this is a film both realistic (injuries really hurt) and silly (as usual someone dies reaching for one last wisecrack instead of their gun).
reviews.author: Sarah Cartland

reviews.text: Charlize Theron absolutely owns Atomic Blonde, both upping her own action game as one of our most exciting big screen action heroes, and elevating the borderline "seen it before" spy/espionage sandbox which the film plays in.
reviews.author: Ed Travis

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is certainly more than just John Wick in high heels, but for what it adds in depth it loses in fun.
reviews.author: Jennifer Heaton

reviews.text: Elevating such thin material without drowning in all the stylistic flourishes is the mark of a genuine movie star, and [Theron's] three big fight scenes are all among the best you'll see this year.
reviews.author: Bob Chipman

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde has its issues, but when it comes to ass-kicking, few can stand shoulder-to-shoulder with Theron's chilly assassin.
reviews.author: Sean Mulvihill

reviews.text: [The film] might not be the cleanest cut, but it's certainly one of the most memorable. Best enjoyed with your favorite liquor. On the rocks, of course.
reviews.author: Johnny Gayzmonic

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is a bit of a mess, but what a fun mess it is.
reviews.author: Micheal Compton

reviews.text: The apocalyptic '80s Europop and punk soundtrack constantly in the air should be enough of an indicator to let your hair down.
reviews.author: Tomas Trussow

reviews.text: Great action does not solely equate to a great movie, and Atomic Blonde ends up being a disappointment.
reviews.author: Matt Hudson

reviews.text: There's little backstory about this titular character... Lorraine is, in many ways, the summation of Theron's fearless career of characters, finally given the proper platform to exist.
reviews.author: Jake Kring-Schreifels

reviews.text: Theron takes to the fight choreography like a violent fish to bloody water. She is exactingly brutal and nearly balletic in her execution.
reviews.author: Derek Deskins

reviews.text: It's a good, not great action movie...though the story could have been a lot better.
reviews.author: Mark Ellis

reviews.text: The story was told just by eighties music videos...that's all it does for the movie.
reviews.author: Kristian Harloff

reviews.text: Leitch uses every tool at his disposal (actors included) to conjure a spectacle with just enough substance to succeed beyond its stellar surface.
reviews.author: Jared Mobarak

reviews.text: As long as Lorraine keeps kicking and punching, the film remains an ally to the audience.
reviews.author: Nguyên Lê

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is propelled by Charlize Theron's blistering performance, but when it comes to the visceral feel and attitude, [David Leitch] has it dialed in.
reviews.author: Aaron Peterson

reviews.text: "Atomic Blonde" mainly suffers from a generic/lackluster narrative and a distracting soundtrack.
reviews.author: Rendy Jones

reviews.text: Brutal, beautiful, and bad-ass, Atomic Blonde is the action heroine we've been waiting for.
reviews.author: Kat Hughes

reviews.text: Suffice to say it's a pleasure to see a mainstream action movie with this type of main character. The movie is certainly worth seeing for this reason, for its optical beauty and for its exceptional kickassery.
reviews.author: Abbie Bernstein

reviews.text: The plot is fine, with a couple of dubious choices best left unspoiled. But I'm not here for the plot. Are you?
reviews.author: Molly Templeton

reviews.text: The star is Theron, who proved her action hero chops in Mad Max: Fury Road and does even better here. She has a commanding presence and long weaponized limbs that the action choreographers put to maximum use.
reviews.author: Pat Padua

reviews.text: A good time - saved by spectacular fight scenes, a colourful cast of supporting characters, and a great lead in Theron.
reviews.author: Kambole Campbell

reviews.text: Theron's unshakable cool is a pleasure to watch, as is the art direction, characterized by bursts of red (a phone booth, a flag, blood!) against the film's gray backdrop.
reviews.author: Glynis Costin

reviews.text: Who do we thank for this refreshing take on the smash-'em-up genre and this thoroughly modern woman in a Bechdel-beating blockbuster?... Thank Charlize Theron
reviews.author: Jane Crowther

reviews.text: If there is an odd nanosecond in which Theron is not gleefully knocking seven bells out of shady enemy agent types, McAvoy is doing one of his wild and crazee kinda guy turns, all spinning eyes and edgy cynicism.
reviews.author: Alison Rowat

reviews.text: With mystery and intrigue, "Atomic Blonde" is everything you'd want in an action-thriller and will satisfy any fan of the genre.
reviews.author: Pamela Powell

reviews.text: Although the plot barely exists, most of "Atomic Blonde" does play out like a mind game. The stakes are there and the action sequences are tight.
reviews.author: Mae Abdulbaki

reviews.text: Charlize Theron is a great choice in virtually every film she's in, but Leitch brought out such a coldness to her that I don't think I'd really seen before.
reviews.author: Stephanie Cooke

reviews.text: I don't think Atomic Blonde is a bad movie and it certainly holds merits in certain aspects, but I left wanting more action and a more cohesive narrative to a story with more potential than given.
reviews.author: Avram Vargas

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is the best espionage 80s music video ever. This film is a fantastic display of stylized movie making and storytelling like we haven't seen in some time.
reviews.author: Aisha Jordan

reviews.text: ... a thinking-person's action flick, with survival a priority at every turn while all the players are manipulating each other... believe Theron was born to play her part.
reviews.author: Kevin A. Ranson

reviews.text: Theron carries the role with a steely-eyed charisma that would make James Bond blush. The character never speaks above a quiet hush, and much prefers to let her actions speak for themselves.
reviews.author: Damian Levy

reviews.text: It's not very original, but it's presented with enough style and acted with enough dedication to be intriguing, exciting and entertaining. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Sebastian Zavala Kahn

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is a chick fronted, action spy flick with teeth.
reviews.author: Amelia Navascues

reviews.text: So while maybe assigning a statuesque platinum blond to deep cover ops isn't the best idea... Atomic Blonde is still good, stylish fun.
reviews.author: Pete Vonder Haar

reviews.text: When it sticks to being a pulpy action homage to the powers of Charlize Theron ... it almost always shoots straight.
reviews.author: Christopher Llewellyn Reed

reviews.text: This movie had so many branches of what it was trying to do that it didn't really do anything.
reviews.author: Jeremy Jahns

reviews.text: Leitch and Theron's success lies in creating an addictive product by deploying a universe governed by tacit laws completely different from those established. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Irene Zoe Alameda

reviews.text: It is the kind of film that's meant to be enjoyed for its visceral thrills more than its logic. If you're seeking great action, it's hard to do better this summer.
reviews.author: Carl Kozlowski

reviews.text: Undoubtedly it is a production that vindicates the sometimes abused action cinema... [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Jonathan Sánchez

reviews.text: [Theron] is firing on all cylinders here, proving blondes not only have more fun, they have more guns - and know how to use them.
reviews.author: Pete Hammond

reviews.text: They live and die by the creativity of their fighting and shooting. These are things you would've thought had no more creative angles to exploit, but with a lot of choreography and a sheen of Berlin cool rinsed through the whole caper, there's plenty.
reviews.author: Ed Williamson

reviews.text: Brutal fight choreography closer to the Bourne movies than "Bad".
reviews.author: Andrew Osborne

reviews.text: The film is a fun-enough summer diversion, but it's not nearly as clever or stylish as it thinks it is.
reviews.author: Al Hoff

reviews.text: Lean, mean, swift, and sure, Atomic Blonde  is the kind of action movie we need in the contemporary morass of CGIed to mush spectacle.
reviews.author: Sean Axmaker

reviews.text: [It's] a deftly paced, hyper-kinetic juggernaut that isn't only ridiculously and painfully-realistically violent ... but also attempts to pull an action movie double-salchow by injecting some genuine intelligence and intrigue.
reviews.author: Ian White

reviews.text: Theron owns "Atomic Blonde."
reviews.author: Loren King

reviews.text: At least the action is another win for director David Leitch; you won't believe how many ways Charlize Theron can kill someone with a rope
reviews.author: Robert Kojder

reviews.text: has style to spare and a canonic soundtrack of '80s New Wave pop, which is used primarily to paper over a tired espionage plot and paper-thin characters
reviews.author: James Kendrick

reviews.text: Charlize Theron absolutely slays the role.
reviews.author: Nathaniel Rogers

reviews.text: Boasting a fantastic soundtrack of '80s hits... [and] a commanding performance by Theron, "Atomic Blonde" delivers visceral kick-ass action with tremendous panache.
reviews.author: Gary M. Kramer

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is a Cold War version of James Bond if Agent 007 were a...female.
reviews.author: Danielle Solzman

reviews.text: This bloody, brutal, bruising and completely uncompromising picture knows where its strengths lie, putting the incomparable stunt work at the forefront.
reviews.author: Courtney Howard

reviews.text: Charlize Theron... definitely proves she's a force to be reckoned with.
reviews.author: J Hurtado

reviews.text: A stylish Cold War thriller with killer visuals, striking performances, and a fond admiration for great moviemaking.
reviews.author: Wesley Lovell

reviews.text: [Atomic Blonde] is one of those movies that are appreciated if you do not take them seriously. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Gaspar Zimerman

reviews.text: Although the plot is underwhelming, the action sequences really stand out with Theron leading the way with a commanding performance.
reviews.author: John Hanlon

reviews.text: The one and only reason why Atomic Blonde becomes a sinfully good action movie is Charlize Theron's supremely choreographed action sequences. She throws the kitchen sink at this film.
reviews.author: Rachit Gupta

reviews.text: It's great to a female-led action film but Atomic Blonde is a few notches below John Wick.
reviews.author: Matthew Toomey

reviews.text: Charlize Theron has created her own version of 'James Bond' - one that could easily last a few more rounds down the line.
reviews.author: Neil Soans

reviews.text: [Charlize] Theron is SPECTACULAR as Lorraine, leading with Lorraine's spy-trained shrewdness and emotional armor, but also touching on moments of vulnerability that she can't afford to expose.
reviews.author: Sarah Marrs

reviews.text: Funny but unoriginal. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Marco Cubillo

reviews.text: Theron's energy in Atomic Blonde is simply mind-boggling. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Emmanuel Báez

reviews.text: One of those films in which one must relax and enjoy the narrative journey with its seduction and violence. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Fausto Ponce

reviews.text: In a nutshell, the best part is watching Theron kicking ass.
reviews.author: Carlos Díaz Reyes

reviews.text: It combines a noir-ish, Sin City-like narrative knowingness, which invites us not to take the whole thing too seriously, with the slick visual style of an expensive advert or music video. Realistic it is not.
reviews.author: Matthew Bond

reviews.text: If style was all that a film needed to succeed, Atomic Blonde would be one of the best movies of the year.
reviews.author: Rob Dean

reviews.text: [Atomic Blonde] cements [Charlize] Theron as one of our greatest modern action stars.
reviews.author: Melissa Leon

reviews.text: The 'female James Bond' label? [Charlize] Theron earns it, but she doesn't need it.
reviews.author: Kevin Fallon

reviews.text: There isn't a better time for a movie like Atomic Blonde...
reviews.author: Joanne Soh

reviews.text: A choreography of blows turned into a form of fine arts. And with Charlize at the center of it all, even more beautiful art. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Ernesto Diezmartinez

reviews.text: [Charlize] Theron strides like a woman born to break both hearts and necks. [James] McAvoy and agency bosses John Goodman and Toby Jones provide amusing backup, but Theron lights the fire that keeps Atomic Blonde burning.
reviews.author: André Hereford

reviews.text: With good editing, rhythm and lots of action, Atomic Blonde is guaranteed entertainment. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Lucero Solórzano

reviews.text: The result is mediocre and doesn't do justice to this spy, whose look evokes Debbie Harry, the leader of Blondie, in her good times. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Adrián Ruiz

reviews.text: Predictable, professional, but at the end decidedly enjoyable. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Diego Batlle

reviews.text: The film draws on the recurring tricks of the espionage story to show how an astute and seductive woman works in the hostile grounds of mistrust and betrayal. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Luis Fernando Galván

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is, ultimately, stylish but too often dull, and far too long.
reviews.author: Harry Readhead

reviews.text: Visually, the film is all that we could expect from a production located in an European country in the late 80's and the action sequences make the film flow.
reviews.author: Sergio López Aguirre

reviews.text: It seemed to promise more but this adaptation is just as cold as its protagonist and the city that receives her. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Mabel Salinas

reviews.text: Apologies to Bond, Bourne and John Le Carré adaptations, but when it comes to slick spy flicks, this blonde really does have much more fun.
reviews.author: Sarah Ward

reviews.text: A non stop of sequences without dialogue, pure minimalism, action as effective as crazy and meta-referential. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Fausto Fernandez

reviews.text: At the end dominates only the facade. Inside, there's just an empty set. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Javier Ocaña

reviews.text: A hybrid between the free action in the sense of the measure, spy cinema and the exhibition of the protagonist. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Luis Martínez

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde wobbles when it piles on layer upon layer of thorny, labyrinthine John Le Carre-style plotting. The rest of the movie doesn't pack the weight or the multidimensional characters necessary to justify it.
reviews.author: Stephen Rebello

reviews.text: How many stylistic trump cards can one movie play before you start wondering whether it has anything else in its deck? For me, so many that I eventually stopped caring what Atomic Blonde might deal next.
reviews.author: Robert Denerstein

reviews.text: Am I obligated to mention that this action film is excellent on its own merits and not because of, or in spite of, a woman being the lead? How exhausting.
reviews.author: Elinor Jones

reviews.text: For the most part, Atomic Blonde is an atomic blast, delivering on the action and allure with style and panache. Theron is one cool action badass.
reviews.author: Ryan Pollard

reviews.text: It's clear immediately that filmmaker David Leitch isn't looking to deliver a gritty spy thriller here...
reviews.author: David Nusair

reviews.text: Exults in the filthy, glorious energy of divided Berlin at its most ragged and hedonistic.
reviews.author: Tim Brayton

reviews.text: Check in for the impressive bursts of violence but be prepared for a surplus of downtime - a near death sentence for a movie called "Atomic Blonde."
reviews.author: J. Olson

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is a film that, despite its flaws, should not be missed.
reviews.author: Andrew Carroll

reviews.text: Even an actor as good as Theron can't turn a set of cynical commercial considerations into a character.
reviews.author: Ryan Gilbey

reviews.text: Theron is magnetic as the ruthless, taciturn spy, in addition to giving a remarkable physical performance. Like Keanu Reeves in "John Wick" and Liam Neeson in "Taken," this is the kind of role that could help define a career.
reviews.author: Greg Maki

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is pure escapism--two hours of an adrenaline rush, nonstop good guys vs. bad guys.
reviews.author: Diane Pershing

reviews.text: It's exhilarating to see Lorraine deliver vicious punches and kicks, using nearby objects to inflict damage.
reviews.author: Mel Campbell

reviews.text: A little overlong and lacking the thematic clout to justify its knotty plot, Atomic Blonde is nevertheless an exhilarating, visceral actioner
reviews.author: Christopher Machell

reviews.text: Charlize Theron works furiously to bring some small weight to a character so feathery she barely manages to remain attached to the screen.
reviews.author: Donald Clarke

reviews.text: An act of sampling that's neither original or personable enough to be a work of art in its own right.
reviews.author: Ed Whitfield

reviews.text: As an action film, it's irreproachable -- just don't expect it to mean anything.
reviews.author: Paul Whitington

reviews.text: !t's all very watchable, Le Carre-esque, Cold War fun.
reviews.author: Aine O'Connor

reviews.text: Despite her best sardonic smouldering and an extensive designer wardrobe, Theron can't make anything compelling of her character, an empty vessel in a spy story that delivers low-IQ le Carré.
reviews.author: Edward Porter

reviews.text: This lean, mean, fighting machine is lost in a very flabby plot.
reviews.author: Andy Lea

reviews.text: You forget to breathe. More importantly, you forget to question the needlessly complicated layers of double-crossing that clog up the third act of an otherwise impressively lean piece of storytelling.
reviews.author: Wendy Ide

reviews.text: It is Theron's unchanging visage and her claim to the female Bond crown that steer the show from one head-scratching but ravishing scene to the next.
reviews.author: Nandini Ramnath

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde would not have worked at all had it not been for two things - Charlize Theron, and a host of crisply choreographed action sequences.
reviews.author: Rashid Irani

reviews.text: The living, breathing, bleeding life of the breathtaking fight scenes cannot overcome confusingly twisty spy intrigue and multiple male gazes on the story.
reviews.author: MaryAnn Johanson

reviews.text: It might be the least feminist film of all time.
reviews.author: Brian Viner

reviews.text: In a victory for style over substance, it forces the instincts to follow the plot and care about the characters to surrender to its and Theron's unrelenting cool.
reviews.author: Matthew Norman

reviews.text: After being the only interesting thing in Mad Max: Fury Road and giving the Fast & Furious crew a run for their money in F8 Charlize Theron here consolidates her position as cinema's most dangerous action movie female.
reviews.author: Jim Schembri

reviews.text: It's the kind of movie in which characters foxily pull down their shades to reveal come-to-bed eyes; the kind of movie in which hot women take luxurious drags off half-smoked cigarettes, and walk with the clip-clop of stilettos on cold concrete.
reviews.author: Rohan Naahar

reviews.text: With these kinds of colourful characters and plenty of tangled intrigue, the film should be a lot of fun. But director David Leitch and writer Kurt Johnstad play it in a way that feels oddly simplistic.
reviews.author: Rich Cline

reviews.text: More cold fusion than hot fission, Atomic Blonde tries to icily merge Berlin-noir and gritty spy-thriller...but it remains more of a strut-about exercise in style.
reviews.author: Brian Gibson

reviews.text: The constant suggestion of cross and double-cross becomes a little wearing as the film heads to the two-hour mark and we never really care about the characters or feel they do more than strike the coolest of poses and the fiercest of blows.
reviews.author: Allan Hunter

reviews.text: This would have been nothing without Theron.
reviews.author: Jamie East

reviews.text: At the end of the day it's an action movie and in that regard Atomic Blonde kicks serious ass.
reviews.author: Elliott Noble

reviews.text: What Theron sells superbly, as she did in Mad Max: Fury Road in 2015, is, simply, ferocity.
reviews.author: Kevin Maher

reviews.text: Theron makes for an extremely compelling kung fu cipher, and there is one extended action scene set in an apartment building that almost justifies the entire endeavor.
reviews.author: Daniel Barnes

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is fun and goofy, but takes itself very seriously.
reviews.author: Jared Rasic

reviews.text: Occasionally muddled and nowhere near as feminist as it should have been, Atomic Blonde still emerges -- battered and bruised -- as a tremendously entertaining action-adventure that deserves to kick-start its own franchise.
reviews.author: Rob Carnevale

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is eventually a lot of fun. Theron's conviction makes what could be sexist fluff into some kind of feminist, personal statement, and a franchise which should thrive.
reviews.author: Nick Hasted

reviews.text: When the relationships between the leading characters are all so superficial and everyone is deceiving everyone else, it is very hard to engage emotionally with the movie.
reviews.author: Geoffrey Macnab

reviews.text: Watching Atomic Blonde is a cinematic crash course. It's a course in how to crash a movie, and a script, and a cast; how to crash them till nothing is left but smoking smithereens.
reviews.author: Nigel Andrews

reviews.text: Theron's magnificent. She lifts a very good action spy thriller into another echelon entirely by her total commitment, professionalism, ability and class ... She's present in a fundamentally and startlingly raw, exposed, intimate way ... I was mesmerised.
reviews.author: CJ Johnson

reviews.text: Most of Leitch's energy goes into the stunts, which have a mesmerising rhythm to them, together with ingeniously intricate choreography.
reviews.author: Sandra Hall

reviews.text: Choreographed beautifully, the camerawork is excellent and watching the fight sequences unfold is almost brutally poetic in nature.
reviews.author: Marija Djurovic

reviews.text: Call off the search for the next James Bond. She's already here.
reviews.author: Jason Best

reviews.text: While it's not a perfect female-centric spy thriller (let's keep trying), Atomic Blonde winks to the future with exciting possibilities.
reviews.author: Tomris Laffly

reviews.text: There are many people willing to watch Charlize Theron commit violent acts; Atomic Blonde is one such vehicle that never fails to deliver in that regard.
reviews.author: Alex Doenau

reviews.text: Charlize Theron is a badass in this sexy, stylish and smart action flick. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Fico Cangiano

reviews.text: Charlize Theron shines but Atomic Blonde needed more highlights.
reviews.author: Harry Guerin

reviews.text: Theron carries it off with style of course ...
reviews.author: Peter Bradshaw

reviews.text: A combination of a spy film and an action movie that doesn't quite materialize, but at least it does present us with a character with enough virtues to be curious about a probable sequel. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Mikel Zorrilla

reviews.text: The action movie of the year has style, attitude, a good soundtrack, imaginative use of furniture as deadly weapons and even quotes Tarkovski. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Daniel de Partearroyo

reviews.text: Theron is totally badass in a relentless thriller that never takes its foot off the gas. Bold and brash, with some of the year's most bruising fight scenes.
reviews.author: Matt Maytum

reviews.text: Leitch imbues a stylistic fervour in Atomic Blonde; a picture illuminated by its indelible neon glow, portraying the city of Berlin in an affectionate, striking light - and yet the film never compromises on its commitment to brutality.
reviews.author: Stefan Pape

reviews.text: Shamelessly smouldering from start to finish and letting its ladies have most of the fun, it's an ace actioner, in perfect tune with our age of disillusionment.
reviews.author: Emma Simmonds

reviews.text: Smashing, adrenaline-propelled spy thriller that's steely and stylish.
reviews.author: Susan Granger

reviews.text: The opening scene promises us the real acting of "Monster." What we get is fist fights and a lariat.
reviews.author: Ron Wilkinson

reviews.text: Even with the playfully stylized flourishes teasing coherency from a pointlessly complicated narrative, the film has a giddy devotion to its own daft momentum.
reviews.author: Jay Horton

reviews.text: Theron throws herself into the colourful maelstrom and comes out (almost) unscathed. We need more spies like this, whether the war is hot or cold.
reviews.author: Kong Rithdee

reviews.text: You could really hate yourself in the morning for being entertained by this coolly preposterous blockbuster.
reviews.author: David 'Mad Dog' Bradley

reviews.text: Broughton may not have 007's arsenal of gadgets, but she does have a signature drink and kick-ass moves that she shows off in the hands-down best fight scene of the year.
reviews.author: Annlee Ellingson

reviews.text: If you like your action impressively staged and literally and figuratively hard-hitting, you could do far worse than what's offered here. (Full Content Review for Parents - Violence, Profanity, Nudity, etc. - also Available)
reviews.author: Jim Judy

reviews.text: The picture rocks and rolls, razzles and dazzles.
reviews.author: Rick Kisonak

reviews.text: Sadly, the spy movie limits its female protagonist by framing her as a sex object for male viewers.
reviews.author: Laura Kenna

reviews.text: Just because Atomic Blonde acknowledges its own derivativeness doesn't excuse it or redeem it, in the end.
reviews.author: Adam Nayman

reviews.text: The fight scenes are gripping because they look real. It's not the stylistic biff and bash of a superhero film but up-close bareknuckled brawling.
reviews.author: Stephen Romei

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde isn't an exact copy of John Wick, and while it isn't as good, there are still excellent elements that help redeem this spy thriller.
reviews.author: Zachary Doiron

reviews.text: I can guarantee you at least one moment of ass-kicking amazement that will make the whole film feel like it was worth seeing.
reviews.author: Liam Maguren

reviews.text: This vicious, contorted spy film is without the smoother qualities of a Bond flick, movies made for an audience that accepts the old movie euphemisms for sex and violence.
reviews.author: Richard von Busack

reviews.text: At best it's a sexy gut-punch of grisly gunfire and A-list gorgeousness, one that will make you wish for secret agent Lorraine Broughton's rapid return in something a bit more substantial.
reviews.author: Alan Jones

reviews.text: A pulsing spy thriller with sex, excellent music and bucketloads of riveting action, Atomic Blonde owes its success to Charlize Theron's ability to carry off the role of agent Lorraine Broughton with such confidence and style.
reviews.author: Wenlei Ma

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is a wild, sordid, violent ride.
reviews.author: Tim Appelo

reviews.text: The movie's ambition of melding spy-thriller drama with gloriously violent action flick falls apart when the former fails to keep pace with the latter.
reviews.author: Eric Walden

reviews.text: The Atomic Blonde that Leitch delivers is a mostly moribund, disjointed, often incomprehensible and vaguely pervy mess. Pity.
reviews.author: Graeme Tuckett

reviews.text: It may be little too concerned with dishing out twist after predictable twist, plot-wise, but that ultimately doesn't really matter when a film looks and feels this cool.
reviews.author: Dominic Corry

reviews.text: An action thriller of hyper-stylised visuals and a catchy 80s soundtrack, it raises your heartbeat to fight-or-flight levels.
reviews.author: Jason Di Rosso

reviews.text: If Atomic Blonde's raison-d'etre is nothing more than to launch an action franchise for Theron, I'm all in.
reviews.author: Eleanor Ringel Cater

reviews.text: Adapting Sam Hart and Antony Johnston's graphic novel The Coldest City, Kurt Johnstad has written a smart exploitation thriller.
reviews.author: Andrea Gronvall

reviews.text: As far as action goes, this is a decent action film, like a James Bond film with some John Wickisms thrown in. The body count is very high. I did not find it very engaging as spy mystery. By the end, I had ceased to care who is on whose side.
reviews.author: Robert Roten

reviews.text: Tinker, tailor, soldier, babes. Not a good look.
reviews.author: Steve Persall

reviews.text: It's cool and brutal, but with such impressive action credentials you almost wish there were fewer plot devices to distract you as Charlize gets up and at 'em.
reviews.author: Helen O'Hara

reviews.text: While the finer points of the story are impossible to follow, Theron deploys bewitching beauty, bone-breaking brawn and belittling eye contact that is impossible to resist.
reviews.author: Leigh Paatsch

reviews.text: Without a doubt one of the greatest action stars of today, Atomic Blonde offers a spectacular platform for Charlize Theron's skills.
reviews.author: Clarisse Loughrey

reviews.text: The action in Atomic Blonde is top-shelf; but the plot that knits it together, crucial to any good spy film, is a whole lot flimsier.
reviews.author: David Sims

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde doesn't reinvent the wheel and never really tries to. It occasionally gets tangled in its own web but it accomplishes what it set out to do.
reviews.author: Matthew Passantino

reviews.text: "Atomic Blonde" musters up just enough heat to blow you away.
reviews.author: Mathew DeKinder

reviews.text: Playing the closest thing we have currently to a female Bond in Atomic Blonde, Theron delivers an electric performance that's brutal and sexy at the same time.
reviews.author: Jason Guerrasio

reviews.text: Wanna see Charlize Theron kick some class? See 'Atomic Blonde.'
reviews.author: Linda Cook

reviews.text: Agent Lorraine Broughton (Charlize Theron) distinguishes herself in many ways among the genre's spies, from her vodka fetish to her bold fashion sense to her savage fighting skills and not least, to her sensual beauty.
reviews.author: Andrew L. Urban

reviews.text: David Leitch's stunt-packed action thriller has enough eye candy in the shapely form of the fabulous Charlize Theron as she dons high fashion before tantalisingly removing it...
reviews.author: Louise Keller

reviews.text: Theron is perennially present, sullen sculpture. No need for backstory, no need for maudlin sentiment. There are a couple of love scenes with a French spy that impress... understated and discomfortingly erotic. Present; tense.
reviews.author: Ray Pride

reviews.text: The real problem is the story. It has enough bits and pieces of action and drama to work as a graphic novel. But it's not enough to make this movie a roller coaster ride.
reviews.author: Rick Bentley

reviews.text: Here's a tip: skip the movie, buy the soundtrack.
reviews.author: Nick Dent

reviews.text: It's a calorie-free serving of simple pleasures, and sometimes that's exactly what you need.
reviews.author: Alison Willmore

reviews.text: The movie's core sequence...makes conscientious and creative use of the three primary elements of action films: fists, guns, cars - all real, and no CG, purists will no doubt notice.
reviews.author: John Serba

reviews.text: At the end of the day, Atomic Blonde is all about doing cool things and looking cool while doing them.
reviews.author: Travis Johnson

reviews.text: You either want to watch Charlize Theron dismantle German cops with cruel efficiency while George Michael's "Father Figure" blares over a boombox, or you don't.
reviews.author: Simon Miraudo

reviews.text: Charlize Theron continues to prove she can hold her own against any man in the action genre and even goes so far as to teach them a few things inside the exhilarating Atomic Blonde.
reviews.author: Jon Espino

reviews.text: There is no one more deserving than Charlize Theron to be crowned Hollywood's next action hero. The story needs work, though.
reviews.author: Valerie Complex

reviews.text: Isn't about anything more than the spy game and how to make it to the end of the board...Then, too, there is Theron, whose kind of un-performance in repose keeps breaking out into ferocious fighting that suggests a feral Jackie Chan.
reviews.author: Peter Canavese

reviews.text: The only thing that keeps you watching - besides the terrific music -- is Theron, who establishes herself as the world's foremost action heroine (sorry Wonder Woman) by bringing style and -- yes! -- beauty to the old-fashioned butt-kicking.
reviews.author: Al Alexander

reviews.text: While there is discussion to be had about her breaking the mold-- the violence and the sex are very much on her terms--this is still a summer action movie.
reviews.author: Daniel M. Kimmel

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is appealingly different, which, storytelling issues aside, makes it a pleasure to immerse yourself in.
reviews.author: Mike McGranaghan

reviews.text: Can a woman step into James Bond's shoes? Duh, says Charlize Theron as she performs the cold-as-ice secret agent shtick backwards, and in red patent-leather stilettos, in the engaging spy-vs-spy thriller Atomic Blonde.
reviews.author: Thelma Adams

reviews.text: What's refreshing is how this slight film has the balls to work in an homage to the great Russian filmmaker Andrei Tarkovsky ... .
reviews.author: Dennis Schwartz

reviews.text: Theron nails the tone with her RuPaul walk, her inner allegiance to Bowie and an Annie Lennox androgyny that defined sexual power in that moment... it almost feels strangely dated, which is another reason why it's worth forgiving the film's many flaws...
reviews.author: Katherine Monk

reviews.text: From the endless and endlessly obvious music cues to the painstakingly rendered neon settings and punk rock accouterments decorating the Communist underground -- this is a movie about nothing beyond that setting.
reviews.author: Robert Levin

reviews.text: Theron is wonderful and Leitch proves he's got impressive directorial chops. As dopey as the central mystery at the heart of this Cold War spy-versus-spy tale might be, I was never bored for a single second.
reviews.author: Sara Michelle Fetters

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde has flaws but in the end it still delivers a great fix for action junkies and inspires hope that even a woman in her 40s can be the lead in an action movie.
reviews.author: Beth Accomando

reviews.text: Theron fights, punches, kicks, and shoots her way through this beautifully choreographed, narratively complex, but slightly sluggish action movie...
reviews.author: Jeffrey M. Anderson

reviews.text: Theron makes Atomic Blonde stylish with her sheer presence.
reviews.author: Tina Hassannia

reviews.text: The action scenes are simply stunning, jaw-dropping even, but there just aren't enough of them to overcome Atomic Blonde's lumbering plot.
reviews.author: Christopher Lawrence

reviews.text: A banging Cold War thriller starring Charlize Theron as an MI6 agent who could break every bone in 007's body (especially Pierce Brosnan).
reviews.author: Eric D. Snider

reviews.text: The plot's pedestrian and familiar, but Theron still yanks the thing over the finish line.
reviews.author: Will Leitch

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is less a movie than a mood. But if you're in the mood for what it has on offer, you'll emerge one happy camper.
reviews.author: Max Weiss

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde can be meandering, sometimes indulgent, yet its infrequent strong scenes overpower the weak ones.
reviews.author: Alan Zilberman

reviews.text: As intriguing as that cat-and-mouse mind game is, it's not until we get to Lorraine touching down in Berlin to hunt for the list that the film generates real pyrotechnics.
reviews.author: Tom Meek

reviews.text: Leitch has worked as a stuntman, and he knows how to stage action. In Atomic Blonde, he finds in 1989 Berlin a nearly ideal environment for photogenic bloodshed.
reviews.author: Dan Lybarger

reviews.text: Having a female action star isn't enough to make a film feminist, and like so many other action films, Atomic Blonde falls short in how it portrays women, and how it portrays same-sex relationships.
reviews.author: Erika W. Smith

reviews.text: If you can get past the cliches and corny characters, and if you want your MTV, some fun fashions and a lady who takes charge, you might fall hard for Theron as the positively nuclear Atomic Blonde.
reviews.author: Michael Smith

reviews.text: You don't go to operas for dancing or ballets for singing, and you don't see Atomic Blonde for anything but a badass female protagonist crunching bones and pulping faces in gratifyingly long takes or remarkable simulations thereof.
reviews.author: David Edelstein

reviews.text: The way Leitch captures all of the fighting, the way Theron sells the hell out of the fisticuffs, and the utter brutality of it all is astounding. It makes you wish that the rest of the movie was even half as exhilarating.
reviews.author: Matt Goldberg

reviews.text: The careless plot bruises the film, otherwise rife with jagged brio, electric visuals and a steamy, gnarled nest of vipers.
reviews.author: Amelia Nierenberg

reviews.text: Whenever Theron isn't punching somebody in the throat we kinda wish she would go off in search of her next victim.
reviews.author: Travis Hopson

reviews.text: If you can live on flashiness alone, it knows how to get the job done. Just don't expect much steak beneath the sizzle.
reviews.author: Rob Vaux

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is junk.
reviews.author: Armond White

reviews.text: Even if the well-choreographed fights, chases and shootouts don't add up to much, they do provide quite the adrenaline rush.
reviews.author: Todd Jorgenson

reviews.text: Leitch's across-the-board approach is purely cosmetic, ever-ready to eschew shades of detail when crass shorthand will suffice.
reviews.author: Matthew Thrift

reviews.text: Perhaps it's not surprising that [Leitch] winds up with something that feels like a tough-minded drama rejiggered into a hard-bodied action-adventure. But it is a bit disappointing. Still, there are consolations.
reviews.author: Matthew Lickona

reviews.text: Taking the good with the bad, Atomic Blonde balances out to a decent entertainment. If you go into it just looking to have fun and don't try to examine the muddled plot too much, then you'll probably have a good time.
reviews.author: Jeff Beck

reviews.text: I'm not going to dismiss any film that has so much inventive action and moves with such style. I just wish someone had written a better movie for the parts where the fists and bullets aren't flying.
reviews.author: Rob Thomas

reviews.text: The idea of staging most of the action to a jukebox of '80s hits might be slightly more effective if the film featured just one song that hasn't already been used to death in movies.
reviews.author: Robert Horton

reviews.text: Atomically underwhelming.
reviews.author: Clay Cane

reviews.text: One amazing action scene is a bright spot in an otherwise dull, impossibly contrived spy thriller that's dressed up with a pulsing 80s synth-pop soundtrack and a darkly lit neon setting.
reviews.author: Eric Melin

reviews.text: Hopefully the inevitable sequel will tell a better story and not rely so heavily on the goodwill of having a female kicking, punching and stabbing the bad guys.
reviews.author: Jeffrey Lyles

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is a stylish, yet uneven, thriller, punctuated by a strong performance by Theron and thrilling action set pieces.
reviews.author: Chris Agar

reviews.text: The 42-going-on-25-year-old actress epitomizes the hashtag #slay as acrobatic, brutal MI6 spy Lorraine Broughton.
reviews.author: Phil Villarreal

reviews.text: Some of the most impressive bone-cracking you're likely to have seen since...well, since the last John Wick movie.
reviews.author: Kurt Loder

reviews.text: Action so raw you'll need your own ice bath after leaving the theater.
reviews.author: Christian Toto

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is bold, brazen and frequently bonkers. But it's also killer.
reviews.author: Barry Hertz

reviews.text: The way it detonates off the screen makes the film live up to its name. It's atomic, and it's a blast.
reviews.author: Adam Graham

reviews.text: Feeling very much like something of the 1980s infused with an even more retro but en vogue martial arts flair, Director David Leitch attacks the graphic novel series "The Coldest City" with unabashed, spirited cool.
reviews.author: Jonathan W. Hickman

reviews.text: Theron makes one hell of a superspy, and it's high time she got her "John Wick" moment.
reviews.author: Sara Stewart

reviews.text: It's not that all the mayhem leading up to that mega-brawl is negligible, mind you; it's just that the big donnybrook/shootout in Atomic Blonde is epic and worth putting up with all the narrative woolgathering.
reviews.author: Jeff Simon

reviews.text: While it's still an enjoyable novelty to spend time during an action movie wondering where I could buy the hero's boots, it's no substitute for a good story.
reviews.author: Moira MacDonald

reviews.text: Unlike its title character, "Atomic Blonde" keeps missing the mark.
reviews.author: Nell Minow

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde may be high in empty calories, but craftsmanship of this level is rare and exhilarating, and worth surviving some muddled plotting to appreciate.
reviews.author: Scott Tobias

reviews.text: We don't need a woman-version of [James Bond]. We need a fully-fledged, complex woman who stands on her own. And Atomic Blonde gives us just that.
reviews.author: Anne Cohen

reviews.text: Unfortunately, Atomic Blonde turns out to be nothing more than a series of sometimes visually impressive, but perpetually banal sequences in a story that lacks interest or coherence, played out by characters who have no substance.
reviews.author: Sarah Watt

reviews.text: Sensational. Jason Bourne and James Bond - this is the genre's alpha successor. Theron is a goddess.
reviews.author: Victoria Alexander

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is the proverbial stained-glass window, only made of very bright and unsubtle neon. Unhindered by other pretensions, however, it marks a brilliant new phase in Theron's career.
reviews.author: Jo Livingstone

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is a routine exercise in spy games, bolstered by some dynamic and brutal action sequences.
reviews.author: Mark Dujsik

reviews.text: As a spy thriller, this is riddled with problems... As an action flick, though, this is stellar.
reviews.author: Kristian M. Lin

reviews.text: It's an atomic triumph of spy thriller action and storytelling.
reviews.author: Michael Heaton

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde may be confusing, empty and disappointing, but when sleek and sinewy British MI6 agent Lorraine Broughton goes DEFCON-1 on the bad guys, boredom dies first.
reviews.author: Dann Gire

reviews.text: As strong and formidable and commandingly tall as Ms. Theron is, she can't rise above the gloom.
reviews.author: Joe Morgenstern

reviews.text: Sometimes in life, all you want is something that looks super awesome, regardless of whether it makes any sense. Atomic Blonde manages that trick in spades.
reviews.author: Emily St. James

reviews.text: Should this be a series, audiences can look back on Atomic Blonde as the erratic-but-on-to-something near miss that it is, in the way that 007 fans honor Dr. No but acknowledge Goldfinger was where the franchise really took flight.
reviews.author: Alonso Duralde

reviews.text: If the James Bond franchise people ever get creative and cast a female 007, Charlize Theron will have to be high on their list of possible candidates.
reviews.author: Peter Howell

reviews.text: If you're an action nut with an affinity for technical movie magic, then Atomic Blonde will almost certainly deliver, but those looking for a coherent story should look elsewhere.
reviews.author: Conner Schwerdtfeger

reviews.text: By the time the action finally arrives in the film's second half, you no longer care. Any energy you might have invested in this ugly world filled with shallow characters has been squandered on silly spy plots and shoddy storytelling.
reviews.author: J.R. Kinnard

reviews.text: "Atomic Blonde" may be a delirious exercise in outré nonsense, but it can also be a brutally effective action picture when the inspiration strikes.
reviews.author: Justin Chang

reviews.text: Leitch has form here - he was one half of the team who gave us Keanu Reeves as a soul-sick assassin in John Wick - and outdoes himself on every imaginable superficial level.
reviews.author: Tim Robey

reviews.text: The visuals in Atomic Blonde pop right off the screen. Leitch periodically zooms in for tight close-ups of the stunning Theron, who conveys a world of emotions with a subtle movement of the eyes.
reviews.author: Richard Roeper

reviews.text: It's sexy and stylish and filled with a bludgeoning dose of '80s pop tunes that do make for a fun time, even if the story gets stuck in the weeds at points. Theron elevates the movie with a commanding performance.
reviews.author: Brad Keefe

reviews.text: While 'Atomic Blonde' might not be bad enough to be renamed 'Atomic Bomb,' after the preposterous postscript has rolled you might agree that despite all the surface flash, it's a dud.
reviews.author: Frank Swietek

reviews.text: Finds pleasures in the way Theron can own her feminism and also more conventional ideas of femininity at the same time. She's both sexy and lethal in couture, and in one sequence uses everything in a kitchen to mop the floor with a room full of men.
reviews.author: Radheyan Simonpillai

reviews.text: With Charlize Theron in fine form, 'Atomic Blonde' is a blast.
reviews.author: Roger Tennis

reviews.text: Headlined by a committed Charlize Theron, Atomic Blonde offers the kind of kick-ass female action hero the non-superhero side of the genre could use more of.
reviews.author: James Berardinelli

reviews.text: An absolute blast, with a never-sexier Theron in some of the best action scenes to hit a screen.
reviews.author: Rafer Guzman

reviews.text: Simultaneously byzantine and dumb ...
reviews.author: Melissa Anderson

reviews.text: Ultimately, "Atomic Blonde" is, like its heroine, something of a machine.
reviews.author: Michael O'Sullivan

reviews.text: I suspect the plot of "Atomic Blonde" doesn't quite track, but with all the back-and-forth and double-agenting, it's possible not to notice.
reviews.author: Chris Hewitt

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is ultimately as distilled and transparent as Lorraine's signature drink, but its remaining ingredients still manage to pack quite a punch.
reviews.author: Marjorie Baumgarten

reviews.text: "Atomic Blonde" is no James Bond adventure, but it's sure to satisfy action junkies.
reviews.author: Calvin Wilson

reviews.text: 'Atomic Blonde' is not a bomb; it's more of a dud. What should have been cinematic fireworks instead is a series of colorful sparklers.
reviews.author: Bob Bloom

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is simply an exercise in style. But what style!
reviews.author: Chris Nashawaty

reviews.text: You don't cast Charlize Theron to lay waste to scores of German and Russian operatives in a Cold War-era spy thriller unless you intend to have her do it in style.
reviews.author: Barbara VanDenburgh

reviews.text: The plot is overwritten, like all recent spy movies, but this one actually has style, and some of the best action choreography in years.
reviews.author: Vincent Mancini

reviews.text: "Atomic Blonde" preserves its core authority, transforming Theron into a "John Wick"-ian force of nature that could kickstart a franchise for the actress.
reviews.author: Brian Orndorf

reviews.text: It looks great: cool, sleek, stylish and sexy, awash in splashes of neon reds and greens on chilly monochrome greys and blues, set to a soundtrack of pumping, pulsating '80s tunes.
reviews.author: Neil Pond

reviews.text: The result is hardly a classic, but it's a damn fine action movie - it works.
reviews.author: Ty Burr

reviews.text: Whether soaking away her pain in an ice cube-filled bath or savagely kicking Commie butt, this "Atomic Blonde" grabs our attention and won't let go.
reviews.author: Robert W. Butler

reviews.text: Glowering from beneath the bangs of her moonbeam-platinum bob, Theron's Broughton is equal parts air, light and iron. We're just the moths clustering around her flame.
reviews.author: Stephanie Zacharek

reviews.text: Theron owns it. She purrs every line and relishes every opportunity to crack her neck while reclining into a leather chair.
reviews.author: Ignatiy Vishnevetsky

reviews.text: Lorraine punches and is punched, and her body is soon mapped by bruises and abrasions. It's a lot of abuse for such puny returns, even if the fights are the best parts of "Atomic Blonde."
reviews.author: Manohla Dargis

reviews.text: Every visual element contributes to defining the characters and moving the story forward, while still looking effortlessly cool.
reviews.author: Josh Bell

reviews.text: fun to watch and shamelessly set in an R-rated universe
reviews.author: Kevin Carr

reviews.text: Theron, who did most of her own martial-arts stunts, is pure bruising poetry in motion. She's a stone-cold badass. How can you resist?
reviews.author: Peter Travers

reviews.text: a sexy, ultra violent action film. Theron is sensational.
reviews.author: Laura Clifford

reviews.text: A sex-and-violence cocktail that wouldn't work as well as it does without an actress as commanding as Theron in the lead.
reviews.author: Michael Gingold

reviews.text: To call her Jane Wick is not only reductive, but a bit insulting - she'd obliterate John handily.
reviews.author: Conor O'Donnell

reviews.text: Rather than exude a stylish swagger, the film reeks of a smug self-satisfaction that undermines Theron's considerable efforts and the genuinely impressive moments of orchestrated carnage.
reviews.author: James Marsh

reviews.text: Is there anything that Charlize Theron can't do?
reviews.author: John Lui

reviews.text: It's as if John le Carré were hired to write something for Schwarzenegger: Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Badass.
reviews.author: Gary Thompson

reviews.text: Blonde is a new wave-y pretzel of twists on top of twists. It gets a satisfying conclusion, though by then you're wondering if you really knew anything about any of the various players.
reviews.author: Brian Truitt

reviews.text: Theron's commanding performance is remarkable because she gives to her character, through her take-no-bull body language and calculating stare, an intelligence that proves she's the right person for the job.
reviews.author: Simon Abrams

reviews.text: Charlize Theron is a Stoli-swilling superspy extraordinaire in David Leitch's worthy follow-up to John Wick.
reviews.author: Rebecca Pahle

reviews.text: Playing a superspy sent into Berlin at the end of the Cold War, Charlize Theron exudes all the icy cool one could want, helping to sell a film that tries too hard to convince us of its badass credentials.
reviews.author: Tim Grierson

reviews.text: The film frequently loses sight of its own action to glibly pay homage to other works.
reviews.author: Jake Cole

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde feels like a punch in the gut. And not just because of the incessant, graphic violence.
reviews.author: Joanna Langfield

reviews.text: Despite its strengths, Atomic Blonde never musters up enough sheer heat to live up to its title.
reviews.author: Don Kaye

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is largely a vacant, hyper-stylistic romp that trades on the thick Cold War atmosphere of far better films (not to mention The Americans). It's all dagger, no cloak. But it has two things going for it.
reviews.author: Jake Coyle

reviews.text: Cold War espionage thriller meets eighties new wave dance party in Atomic Blonde.
reviews.author: Julian Roman

reviews.text: After a brisk, efficient, uber-cool first hour, all New Wave tunes and sexy neon lighting, the second hour drags into dullness.
reviews.author: Katie Walsh

reviews.text: Charlize Theron has a new action franchise for the taking if she wants it.
reviews.author: Scott Mendelson

reviews.text: Theron keeps her cool throughout the pummelling gyrations, but the film strains to achieve a breathless panache and a lurid swagger for which David Leitch's direction is too heavy-footed and literal ...
reviews.author: Richard Brody

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde might not be a game-changer, but it's an incredibly solid outing that will definitely rattle around in your head for a while once it's done.
reviews.author: Victoria McNally

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde has attitude aplenty and the fervent style of its execution is so staggering and exciting to watch that it made it one of the best times I've had in the theater this year.
reviews.author: Alex Welch

reviews.text: More John Le Carré than "Jane Wick," and less James Bond and more one of the grounded Bond knock-offs. (Think the Harry Palmer films featuring a bespectacled Michael Caine.)
reviews.author: Matt Prigge

reviews.text: Atomic gives us moments of kinetic joy and a cinephile intelligence that makes it more memorable than that Wanted with Angelina Jolie and (again) James MacAvoy. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Marcos Gandía

reviews.text: Thank you for finally making LGBT action, and not making it exploitive.
reviews.author: Fred Topel

reviews.text: It may not be the deepest modern action film we've seen, but Theron absolutely fricking rules in Atomic Blonde.
reviews.author: Heather Wixson

reviews.text: Theron is the hero we need right now: As devilishly self-serving and smooth as Bond, as physically dynamic and stoic as Wick, Lorraine is confidently equipped to join the legacy of great movie action heroes and she doesn't need your permission.
reviews.author: Britt Hayes

reviews.text: Audiences will be helpless but to bow down, as Atomic Blonde has come to take your breathe away, and leave you giddy, gasping for more.
reviews.author: Kristy Puchko

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is neither simple or relatable, which unfortunately keeps it being from a classic. But David Leitch's spy thriller... boasts a deceptively cunning performance from Charlize Theron, and one of the best action scenes I've seen in years.
reviews.author: Josh Kurp

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is a story of a hidden dealings and murky agendas, but only one certainty: On the heels of her scene-stealing moments in Mad Max, Theron's action stardom is now anything but secret.
reviews.author: Eric Kohn

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde has one of the greatest action scenes ever filmed.
reviews.author: Peter Hall

reviews.text: Theron has once again crashed the action-hero boy's club. Something tells me no one will be complaining.
reviews.author: Joanna Robinson

reviews.text: Given that the film gives us ample time to catch our breath in-between the punching, kicking and shooting it will be easier to wish that it had all been condensed into an accessible YouTube video of just the action bits.
reviews.author: Erik Childress

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde is a new-wave action rehash made better by Charlize Theron's steely spy game and David Leitch's radiating style.
reviews.author: Matt Donato

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde finds surprising depth by delving into the existential considerations of spycraft, questioning exactly how and when a good spy who does terrible things can stop believing that they're doing good.
reviews.author: Evan Narcisse

reviews.text: Atomic Blonde offers up a heady mix of modern action and '80s throwback, which doesn't amount to much but is awfully nice to look at.
reviews.author: Joshua Starnes

reviews.text: The twists are compelling enough to propel the movie from one action set-piece to the next.
reviews.author: Ross Miller

reviews.text: Theron is great in it, and some of the fight scenes sing, but an action movie needs focus and energy, and ATOMIC BLONDE is utterly bereft of both.
reviews.author: Meredith Borders

reviews.text: The Cold War rarely felt this cold.
reviews.author: William Bibbiani

reviews.text: As enjoyable as Atomic Blonde can be at times, its main utility may be its demonstration that Theron deserves better than this.
reviews.author: John DeFore

reviews.text: So much uncut hardboiled posturing proves exhausting over a nearly two-hour runtime, and with zero emotional stakes and a plot that is both difficult and seemingly pointless to follow, there's a fundamental emptiness behind all the flash.
reviews.author: Andrew Barker

reviews.text: Anyone who grew up watching Michael Mann's Miami Vice will be on cloud nine reveling at how the New Wave classics turn the film's feverish action into something of a cotton candy dream - sugary, weightless, creative, and beautiful.
reviews.author: Michael Roffman

synopsis: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies.
